&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the SQLSTATE as a five-character string (for example "42S02" or "HY000"), see PDO::errorCode.
If the connection fails in PDO::__construct, returns the driver-specific error code as an int instead (for example 1045 for access denied in MySQL).
The code parameter of Exception::__construct only accepts an int, so passing this value to it when rethrowing the error as a different exception throws a TypeError. Casting it to int loses information ("HY000" becomes 0). Pass the original exception as the previous parameter instead.
